properties.TRAIL_DESC: This is a long, dog-friendly trail that follows unpaved fire roads. Head south from the Briones Overlook Staging area and make a right (northwest) across the Briones Reservoir Dam. The trail follows the crest of Sobrante Ridge to the north side of the reservoir. Past the Hampton trail intersection, the trail continues along the reservoir margin for another five and a half miles to the Bear Creek staging area. If you are traveling without a furry companion, you can make a very long loop (roughly 13 miles) by continuing onto Bear Creek Trail, which circles back to the Briones Overlook Staging area.
properties.LABEL: Oursan

Trail use permits are not required within the park.
